summary: Blocker: src/daos/groupDAO.js:47-55 soft-deletes only groups. Active group_members and section_groups remain, while SectionDAO.hasAccess and sync access queries do not require groups.deleted_at IS NULL. Deleting a non-last linked group therefore fails to revoke its members’ private Section access. Blocker: src/services/syncService.js:57-69 computes hydrate_section_ids but performs no backfill; src/daos/syncDAO.js:282-299 still retrieves existing-binder messages only when updated after the prior token, so newly granted users do not receive historical Section content required by the hydrate step. Blocker: src/daos/syncDAO.js:89-95 returns every Section, including private titles and existence, to every binder member during sync. D3 permits inaccessible private metadata only to manager+, so ordinary members receive unauthorized metadata despite the filtered REST list. No authorization, revoke, grant-hydration, or sync-scope tests were added.
